questionText: What is the Uniform Interface constraint and what are its four sub-constraints?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can name and explain all four uniform-interface constraints through one order representation and state the benefit and cost.
outOfScope: Claiming any JSON response is self-descriptive
prerequisites: HTTP methods, headers, and media types

claims.statement: REST's uniform interface requires resource identification, manipulation through representations, self-descriptive messages, and hypermedia as the engine of application state.
A uniform interface improves visibility and independent evolution but can be less efficient than an application-specific interaction style.

examples.title: Order representation with self, confirm, and customer relations

validation.expected: The media type and link relations give the controls their public meaning

visuals.title: Four parts of the uniform interface

notes: The answer keeps HATEOAS inside uniform interface and separate from optional code-on-demand.

review.notes: Definitions and architectural trade-offs were checked against Fielding; rendered visual and final editorial review remain open.
